subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should Google Chat add an opt-in user-OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub mode so OpenClaw can ingest all Space messages without @mentions?
rationale: The remaining request changes credential type, consent/scopes, subscription behavior, and which Space messages OpenClaw is allowed to see, so code automation should not choose that policy boundary.

options.title: Design an opt-in ingestion mode
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved Google Chat OAuth or Workspace Events design with explicit config, docs, security review, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep service-account webhooks mention-only
options.body: Document the current Google Chat limitation and leave all-message Space ingestion outside the supported channel contract for now.

recommendation.title: Design an opt-in ingestion mode
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved Google Chat OAuth or Workspace Events design with explicit config, docs, security review, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on Google Chat inbound Space/DM classification makes this the strongest available routing signal for the remaining ingestion decision.
